title: 单月飙升超92%！MiniMax交出亮眼半年报，总市值强势回升至1249.56亿港元
content:
Recently, the capital market has seen a strong rebound, and the AI company MiniMax has experienced a significant recovery after previous stock price fluctuations. Since the recent low point on July 27th, the stock price has risen by more than 92% within about a month. On the latest trading day, the stock price surged by more than 19% during the session, closing at 357.8 HKD, driving the company's total market value back to 124.956 billion HKD.
This strong stock performance is mainly attributed to the company's impressive mid-2026 earnings report. Data shows that MiniMax has achieved explosive growth in both business scale and commercialization. In particular, the token (unit) consumption in July showed a geometric increase, reaching 20 times that of January this year. In terms of financial data, the company's revenue in the second quarter grew by 81.8% compared to the previous quarter, while the annual recurring revenue (ARR) as of August has broken through the 800 million USD mark.
Looking at the first half of the year, MiniMax's total revenue reached 117 million USD, representing a significant 283.1% year-over-year growth. This half-year revenue performance has already surpassed the total of the entire previous year. Looking back at the market performance over the past few months, the company's capitalization process has drawn much attention. Not only did it officially list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at the beginning of this year, but it was also officially included in the Hong Kong Stock Connect in August, demonstrating the continuous recognition of its technological strength and commercial prospects by the capital market.

report.summary: MiniMax股价单月飙升92%，市值回升至1249.56亿港元
report.background: MiniMax是中国头部AI大模型公司，年初在港交所上市，但此后股价一度波动。7月27日股价触及低点后，随资本市场回暖及公司发布亮眼半年报，股价在一个月内反弹超92%。半年报显示其业务规模与商业化进展远超预期，同时公司8月被纳入港股通，进一步增强了市场信心。这一表现也映射出市场对AI赛道从情绪低谷转向价值重估。
key_points: 股价从7月27日低点累计涨超92%，最新收盘357.8港元，总市值重新站上1249.56亿港元，市场情绪明显逆转。
7月token消耗量达到1月的20倍，显示API调用量和客户需求呈指数级增长，业务规模快速扩张。
二季度营收环比增长81.8%，上半年总收入1.17亿美元，同比大增283.1%，已超过去年全年收入水平。
截至8月，年度经常性收入（ARR）突破8亿美元，商业化进程显著提速，盈利模式得到验证。
公司年初在港交所上市，8月被纳入港股通，科技实力和商业前景持续获得资本市场认可。
report.impact: MiniMax的高增长表明大模型公司能够实现规模化商业变现，可能带动资本重新评估AI初创企业的估值逻辑。对开发者而言，token消耗激增意味着更多产品接入其API，但也需关注调用成本和模型选型。对普通用户来说，未来将看到更多由MiniMax驱动的应用和服务，尤其在文本、语音和视频交互方面，体验有望进一步丰富。
report.tools: 建议关注MiniMax开放平台及API文档，试用其文本、语音、视频等模型能力；同时可留意Hugging Face上的相关开源模型作为对比参考，以便评估不同方案的性能与成本。
